create_NestedDictionaryDataset: create a NestedDictionaryDataset from a nested dictionary of FairseqDataset objects with matching lengths
flatten_nested_dict: use _flatten to recursively flatten a nested dictionary into dot-separated keys in an OrderedDict
unflatten_dict: use _unflatten to reconstruct a nested dictionary from a flattened OrderedDict with dot-separated keys
collate_samples: call collater on a NestedDictionaryDataset to merge a list of samples into a mini-batch for model forwarding
prefetch_dataset_indices: call prefetch on a NestedDictionaryDataset to prefetch data for the given list of sample indices
